tasks.subject: Task 1: AudioDiagnostics data + dBFS helper
tasks.description:
**Goal:** JVM-testable diagnostics data types and an RMS→dBFS helper, idle-safe, with post-denoise/attenuation derived.

**Files:**
- Create: app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/AudioDiagnostics.kt
- Test: app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/AudioDiagnosticsTest.kt

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- rmsDbFs known levels + -120 silence floor, no NaN/-Inf
- postDenoiseDbFs == postGainDbFs - agcGainDb
- rnnoiseAttenuationDb == rawDbFs - postDenoiseDbFs; NaN when idle
- deterministic, no Android imports

**Verify:** JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests "*AudioDiagnosticsTest"


tasks.subject: Task 2: PlatformAudioEffects read-only probe
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Probe AEC/NS/AGC state on a capture session read-only (OboeTester's pattern minus the toggle), holding handles for the session and releasing on close.

**Files:**
- Create: app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/PlatformAudioEffects.kt

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- per-effect isAvailable + create(sessionId) + read getEnabled via .enabled; NO setEnabled in the file
- handles held as fields; close() releases all null/exception-safe
- create/getEnabled throw -> enabled=null, no crash
- companion deviceModel() + unprocessedSupported(AudioManager)

**Verify:** JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" ./gradlew :app:compileDebugKotlin

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/PlatformAudioEffects.kt"], "verifyCommand": "JAVA_HOME=\"/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home\" ./gradlew :app:compileDebugKotlin", "acceptanceCriteria": ["per-effect isAvailable + create + read .enabled; NO setEnabled", "handles held; close() releases null/exception-safe", "throws -> enabled=null, no crash", "companion deviceModel + unprocessedSupported"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Stage metering + diagnostics StateFlow
tasks.description:
**Goal:** TransmitProcessor exposes lastVadProb; AudioIn gains a captureInfo() seam; AndroidAudioIn runs the probe; AudioVoiceEngine measures raw + post-gain RMS periodically and emits diagnostics: StateFlow<AudioDiagnostics>.

**Files:**
- Modify: app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/TransmitProcessor.kt
- Modify: app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/AudioVoiceEngine.kt
- Test: app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/AudioVoiceEngineDiagnosticsTest.kt

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- TransmitProcessor exposes lastVadProb; existing TransmitProcessorTest passes
- AudioIn.captureInfo()=null default; AndroidAudioIn runs+releases PlatformAudioEffects, returns CaptureInfo
- engine.diagnostics seeded at start + updated ~every 500ms (raw/post-gain/gainDb/prob/connected)
- new JVM test: steady capture populates diagnostics, connected=true

**Verify:** JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests "*TransmitProcessorTest" --tests "*AudioVoiceEngine*"

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/TransmitProcessor.kt", "app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/AudioVoiceEngine.kt", "app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/AudioVoiceEngineDiagnosticsTest.kt"], "verifyCommand": "JAVA_HOME=\"/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home\" ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests \"*TransmitProcessorTest\" --tests \"*AudioVoiceEngine*\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["TransmitProcessor exposes lastVadProb; existing test passes", "AudioIn.captureInfo seam; AndroidAudioIn runs+releases probe", "engine.diagnostics seeded + periodic update", "new JVM diagnostics test passes"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Audio-diagnostics screen + nav
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A read-only "Audio diagnostics" screen (opened from a Settings ListItem) that renders MumbleManager.audioDiagnostics.

**Files:**
- Create: app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/ui/AudioDiagnosticsScreen.kt
- Modify: app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/ui/SettingsScreen.kt
- Modify: app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/ui/DumbleApp.kt

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- AudioDiagnosticsScreen shows per-effect available+enabled (Y/N/unknown), unprocessed support, device model, self-report caveat, live raw/post-denoise/post-gain dBFS + RNNoise attenuation + AGC gain + VAD prob
- SettingsScreen Audio diagnostics ListItem + onOpenDiagnostics param + @Preview updated
- DumbleApp collects audioDiagnostics + showDiagnostics nav (back to Settings)
- assembleDebug builds

**Verify:** JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug
